articles.title: Small-cap funds lead FY27 so far, beating mid, flexi and large-cap funds; JM Small Cap tops chart with over 32% return

articles.title: Adding equity does not always increase portfolio risk: New study compares different debt, equity and gold portfolios
articles.summary: A 100% debt portfolio delivered an average annual return of 6.79% with volatility of 6.38%.
